newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index ends up on A share rise.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index ends up on A share rise.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index reversed morning losses to end up on Friday with domestic investors encouraged by rises in the A share market late in trading, brokers said.
The B index rose 0.778 points or 1.12 percent to 70.120 points on volume of 13.9 million shares worth $6.2 million against $7.1 million on Thursday.
The A share index jumped 49.55 points or 4.22 percent to 1,222.436 points on volume of 699.2 million shares worth 8.4 billion yuan, little changed from Thursday's 8.3 billion yuan.
Shanghai's A share index jumped after Thursday's falls on institutional support for selective stocks which triggered large follow-up buying late in the session, brokers said.
They said that the A shares jump late in the session sparked buying by domestic investors on the B share market and reversed the morning's losses.
"Trading by domestic investors is the main reason for movements on the B share market at the moment with overseas investors staying on the sidelines in the company reporting season," one broker said.
"The day's trading volume was thin despite the rise, indicating that the potential for a further rise is small in the absense of fresh capital," a second broker said.
Of 43 B shares, 42 traded with 26 up, five flat and 11 down.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi was the star on speculative institutional buying, jumping $0.068 or 6.66 percent to $1.088 on volume of 69,000 shares.

Real estate developer Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development traded the most on liquidation amid expectations of its unpromising 1996 result, but some domestic institutions continued to support it.
It ended flat at $0.940 on volume of 1.6 million shares.
On the A share market, the SSE 30 blue chip index rose 146.858 points or 4.68 percent to 3,283.705 points.

Shanghai Wangchunhua Industrial was the star on institutional buying ahead of the close, surging 1.07 yuan to its daily 10 percent limit-up of 11.75 yuan on volume of 694,300 shares. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
